description: Atlyn Heatmap helps analysts compare a numeric measure across a row category and a column category, such as product revenue by region or defect counts by production line. Keep color scaling separate from the underlying numbers. Choose global, per-row or per-column color scopes, sequential blue or zero-centered diverging colors, raw values, explicitly confirmed additive shares, or ratios using a supplied model denominator. Per-group legends explain when colors are not comparable across groups. Zero, BLANK, invalid, absent and unknown/unloaded intersections have distinct states. Sticky headers, keyboard navigation, model-backed selection, host tooltips, high-contrast presentation and RTL layout support exploration. Up to three numeric or text measures can provide tooltip context. Manual row loading and visible completeness notices disclose data that has not been delivered. Limits and semantics: up to 500 rows, 100 columns and 20,000 dense cells; row capacity decreases as columns increase. Exactly 100 returned columns is conservatively flagged as possibly reduced. Computed shares require nonnegative additive values and complete data. Explicit positive-denominator ratios can be used on partial data. Display labels and tooltips are bounded while original model selection identities are retained. Small tiles and large fonts may require more space. This is not a correlation engine,…
